nodes.label: Extra Exports (Wiki, Neo4j, FalkorDB, SVG, GraphML, MCP)
nodes.norm_label: extra exports (wiki, neo4j, falkordb, svg, graphml, mcp)

nodes.label: EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS Confidence Rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete scores keep models from collapsing confidence to a binary.

nodes.label: Node ID Format Rule
nodes.rationale: Full-path stems must match AST IDs to avoid ghost-duplicate nodes.

nodes.label: --update Incremental Re-extraction
nodes.rationale: Only changed files are re-extracted; build_merge replace-on-re-extract prevents stale nodes (#1344).

nodes.label: Part A: Structural AST Extraction
nodes.rationale: Deterministic and free; no API key needed for code.

nodes.label: Manifest & Cost Tracker
nodes.rationale: Only semantic files that produced output are stamped, so failed chunks get re-queued (#2015).

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction Cache
nodes.rationale: Entries are keyed to the extraction-spec prompt so prompt changes invalidate stale results (#1939).

nodes.label: Part B: Semantic Extraction via Parallel Subagents
nodes.norm_label: part b: semantic extraction via parallel subagents
nodes.rationale: Subagents dispatched in one message for parallelism; must be general-purpose so they can write chunk files.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: Expands the question against the graph vocabulary so a wording mismatch does not collapse results, without inventing tokens.

nodes.label: Fast Path: Query Existing Graph
nodes.rationale: If graph.json exists and the request is a question, skip the rebuild and query directly.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent edges; use AMBIGUOUS; always show token cost and raw cohesion scores.

nodes.label: No API Key Required Principle
nodes.rationale: The host agent acts as the LLM; Gemini is used only if its key is set.

nodes.label: graph.json Shrink Guard (#479)
nodes.rationale: Refuses to overwrite a larger existing graph so a failed extraction never clobbers good output.

nodes.label: Run graphify update after code changes
nodes.norm_label: run graphify update after code changes
nodes.rationale: Keeps the graph current using AST-only extraction with no API cost.

nodes.label: Selected Accounts Dropdown

nodes.label: Chat Header (avatar, name, expiry countdown)
nodes.rationale: Shows 'Expires in 23:50:04' countdown so agents know the remaining session window.

nodes.label: Search Closed Chats Input + Filter Button

nodes.label: Conversation List Item
nodes.rationale: Avatar, name + timestamp, preview + status badge, divider, then WhatsApp channel/account row truncated with ellipsis; selected item (Nanda Developer) uses a #3D3D3D rounded card.

nodes.label: Expired Status Badge
nodes.rationale: Red pill badge signalling the messaging window (e.g. WhatsApp 24h session) has expired.

nodes.label: Kouventa Chat Screen (Interactions > Chat)
nodes.rationale: Reference UI screenshot of the production dark-theme omnichannel chat console; three-column layout (icon sidebar, conversation list, chat canvas) used as visual source of truth for the design system.

nodes.label: Left Navigation Sidebar (icon-only)
nodes.rationale: Dark #2C2C2C column with K logo at top, outlined search button, white outline icons grouped by gray rules; active Chat item is a green rounded square.

nodes.norm_label: chat status tabs (assigned / idle / bot / closed)
nodes.rationale: Conversations are partitioned by lifecycle state; Closed tab active shows 'Closed or Inactive Chats'.

nodes.label: Take Over Button
nodes.rationale: Primary green action letting a human agent take over a conversation (e.g. from bot or another agent).

nodes.label: Outgoing Template Message Bubble
nodes.rationale: Wide solid-green WhatsApp template bubble (event invitation in Indonesian) with header media, emoji-prefixed date/time/location lines, and 'QA Developer' footer.

nodes.label: Top Header Bar (breadcrumb, notifications, user avatar)
nodes.norm_label: top header bar (breadcrumb, notifications, user avatar)
nodes.rationale: Rounded #292929 card with 'Interactions > Chat' breadcrumb; right side has monitor icon, bell with green count badge (40), and HE avatar with online dot.

nodes.label: Dark Theme Surface Layering
nodes.rationale: Hierarchy expressed via progressively lighter grays (#1E1E1E page, #292929 header, #2C2C2C panels, #3D3D3D selected/canvas) instead of borders.

nodes.label: --color-primary #0EC83A Brand Green
nodes.rationale: Single brand green; no other greens allowed to preserve brand consistency.

nodes.label: Tailwind + CSS Variable Tokens Implementation
nodes.rationale: Tokens defined once in :root and a dark scope; components reference variables, not raw hex, so theming stays centralized.
